about: Where `combobite --refresh-prices` gets each chain's store prices. See docs/price-refresh.md.
Each source is an Apify actor that reads one restaurant's own online menu. A chain with no entry here (McDonald's) keeps its hand-entered prices.
'input' is sent to the actor as-is, plus the location you type, in the field named by 'location_field'.
'item_names' lists other names the store's menu may use for one of our items, by item id. Sizes are added automatically ('Medium French Fries', 'French Fries | Medium').
'aliases' gives exact menu names for one priced entry, by key: 'item_id/size', 'combo:id', 'bundle:id' or 'add_on:id'. A variant of a menu item is written 'Item name | Variant name'.
The names below are first guesses from each chain's website. Run a refresh with --dry-run, read the 'no match' lines, and add the store's real names here.
